info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Reminders API provides users with the ability to retrieve reminders for scheduled healthcare appointments. This API serves as a crucial tool for healthcare providers and patients, ensuring that appointments are not missed. Users can access comprehensive lists of reminders, which enhances patient engagement and promotes timely healthcare services. The API is particularly beneficial for healthcare professionals implementing reminder systems or applications aimed at improving patient adherence to appointment schedules.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch reminders associated with their scheduled appointments. It provides essential information to help users stay on track with their commitments.
